topics.title: Rich Little's Chaotic Impressions
topics.summary: During a live broadcast, comedian Rich Little attempts to maintain his Jimmy Stewart and Jack Nicholson personas while delivering impressions of various figures including Presidents Nixon and Carter. He discusses his wife, Mel Torme, the challenges of fame, and showcases his extensive videotape collection featuring over 1000 voices amidst chaotic interactions with callers and an attempt at a promotional segment.

topics.title: Mike Tyson Ticket Giveaway & Carson Impressions
topics.summary: Howard and Gilbert count instances of 'man' and ‘dude’ to win Mike Tyson tickets while discussing Jack Benny’s confused phone call with Johnny Carson. They then delve into Rich Little’s impressions, including a bizarre attempt at George Bush and his fascination with Meg, culminating in impersonations of both figures.

topics.title: Rock Stars and Model Wives - Commercial Chaos
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss securing rock stars for station appearances while also addressing Jackie’s claim of being a Ford Model at age 30. They debate whether it's appropriate for her to pursue modeling, referencing motorcycle-riding alcoholics and potential commercial work, with frequent interruptions from callers.

topics.title: Radio Show Banter and Celebrity Speculation
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts engage in playful debates about the viability of an older actress pursuing Hollywood success while speculating on Madonna’s relationship with Robin Bird and discussing audience reactions at Billy Joel's concerts. topics.title: Madonna’s Backstage Visit & Nurse Richard
topics.summary: During the radio show, Howard Stern recounts an unusual encounter with Madonna who arrived disguised as a nurse and brought along staff. They discuss Stuttering John's song while also referencing a phone call from Larry King and a bizarre incident involving Richard Simmons dressed in a nurse’s outfit.

topics.title: Richard Simmons' Aerobics Mishap
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Richard Simmons attempts to promote his new aerobics video while Howard and Robin relentlessly tease him about dressing as a nurse. The conversation quickly devolves into tangents involving phone calls, discussions of weight loss, and an uncomfortable attempt to play the tape for listeners, culminating in a bizarre exchange with Deborah Stern.
